articles.summary: KFAR SAVA, Israel - September 2, 2026 - Silicom Ltd. (NASDAQ: SILC), a leading provider of networking and data infrastructure solutions, today announced that it has secured a Design Win from a new customer, a tier-1 cloud-based cyber security giant, for a Silicom Edge Networking device featuring integrated 5G wireless connectivity.
